decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is the backbone of the firm's announced push to bind mobile communication and embodies substantial sunk R&D, so management will persist despite its lower web visibility in 2020–2021.

Mobile PDF signing is tied to the firm's publicly stated move into online contract signing, and the pandemic-driven demand for remote signing lets management read weak results as a temporary timing issue.
The email-to-app robot is a peripheral add-on that has not been visible since 2018, so public commitment to it has faded and its functions can be folded into the core secure channel.
The payment compliance suite supports the regulatory positioning the firm's identity rests on, and slow compliance adoption cycles still offer a plausible temporary explanation for modest results.
